questions.question: Why are automation rules essential for a GitHub Project board?
choices: They make the board look more professional
They ensure items move through statuses automatically, keeping the board accurate without manual updates
They prevent team members from creating new issues
questions.explanation: Without automation, team members must manually move items between columns. This rarely happens consistently, so the board becomes stale and unreliable. Automation keeps it accurate.

questions.question: What is the purpose of having multiple views (Board, Table, Roadmap) on a single project?
choices: Each view shows completely different data
Different audiences need different perspectives — daily standups need board, stakeholder demos need roadmap, workload analysis needs table
GitHub requires at least 3 views per project
questions.explanation: Board view works for daily standups, Table view lets PMs filter by assignee for 1-on-1s, and Roadmap view shows timeline for stakeholder demos. Same data, different perspectives.
